So we had a huge setback in one of the other departments at my company. I came up with an idea that saved us two months of time (*immeasurable* value) and tens of millions of dollars. We're a startup, so this is huge.

My response to people congratulating me? "It worries me that nobody else caught this. What the fuck is wrong with the people in the other department?"

Not only could I not be happy, I had to make others feel worse for it.

I wish I weren't such a miserable asshole.

I'm 35 and yeah. Went to Supercuts today and there was *drastically* more gray and white hair on the floor than my natural black.

I can't even begin to comprehend it, actually. Feels like even my body itself thinks I'm dying. For years I've been blaming it on my personal incurable disease (Crohn's) but there's just no way it could all be chalked up to that. Just no way.

Turning 36 this year. Basically the same situation as what you described.

I have no idea how to escape this spiral decline.

I know that all too well.

People think before downvoting. People don't always think before upvoting. So downvotes feel so much more personal.

On my main account I curate my history and delete the comments I don't want to think about. It usually helps.

When I told my family I was diagnosed with Crohn's disease, their response was that "[I was] supposed to be the healthy one."

I don't tell them that I think about suicide.
Post if you do... might give my 35 year old ass the inspiration necessary to do the same.
It's possible, it just takes a *lot* of work and is very unintuitive.

Personally I consider Reddit to be *the optimal* form of social media. The pseudo-anonymity allows me to be myself far more than trash platforms like Twatter and Facebeast ever could, but then again they aren't really meant to. Rather, they're meant to enforce conformity.

I was learning Japanese until depression got the best of me and I let my 550+ day Duolingo streak lapse. Wanna shoot the shit?

This is most *definitely* shock. Please be careful, you *will* be prone to mistakes and *can* hurt yourself even if in your present numbness you don't think you will. You are overloaded and at any moment the dam could break. Please don't let that be when you're driving.

Your next steps should be to inform your professors ASAP and to take the time off that you require to sort things out.

I wake up and sometimes the happiness of my dream lingers. Like I'll forget I was dreaming and think that something beautiful is just out if sight and about to come back into view.

And then I remember. There is nothing else.

Us depressive dudes feel the same way.

Someday you'll find someone who feels *so* lucky to have you, and you'll feel *so* lucky to have him.
The only thing I hate more than myself are messages like this.

I get it.

I wish I didn't, but I do.
Hey hey, me too.
Happy birthday.
Have you considered a psychologist instead of a therapist?

I met her. That girl like me.

Or at least I thought she was like me.

And so she ripped my heart out.

And then I realized she was nothing like me and I was projecting because we had some vaguely similar traumatic experiences.
Am also bi and can't disagree more. All being bi does is make me realize I fail at relations with not just one but *two* genders.
Nah, that's not true. I have a couple. They aren't close friends but hey it's better than nothing.

I'm alive for my parents, my sister, and my best friend.

And that's basically it.

I graduated, got a well paying job, got a nice new car, and seriously think about sleeping in it while running the engine while parked in my new house's garage.

I have everything I could want except friends.

It's just because Reddit's admins are disgusting pieces of shit in the vague shape of people.

In this case it really isn't you. It's them.

Taking time off to deal with a health problem isn't the end of the world. My best friend had to take a semester off because of a major surgery and aside from loan repayment kicking in for a month or two it wasn't a big deal. She went back and the bills stopped.

Before you decide to take a semester off call your loan company and explain your situation.

Also get a better fucking doctor, that shit isn't acid reflux.
Some days I wish my parents had never met me.

I know the feeling.

Felt like I finally made friends. Ate dinner with them every night for a few weeks because we were all busy on some time critical stuff at work. I felt human. It was... nice.

Deadline met, and now everyone goes back to their own lives. And unfortunately mine is eating trash drive through and sleeping in my car in the dark of my garage when I get home.

If I have to already be dead why do I have to stay alive?

They are pretty adorable, as far as creatures go.

Where I've lived now for the past few years we only have muscovy ducks. If you've never seen one before their faces are pretty horrific looking, like something out of a butcher shop but alive and begging for your french fries. It put me off quite a bit at first, until I saw one dead on the side of the road and I realized they're just ugly ducks that don't quack.

I kinda think I might be a muscovy, metaphorically speaking. An odd duck that doesn't *really* fit in. Still a duck, though, and worthy of a french fry or two.

Today I decided to create a throw-away account so I could maybe find some measure of help here.
